description: This file defines the DeviceAuthStore system for managing device authentication tokens, including storing, loading, and clearing tokens with associated roles and scopes. It uses Codable for JSON serialization and handles file operations for persistence.

classes.name: DeviceAuthEntry
classes.description: Encapsulates authentication token details including token string, role, scopes, and last update timestamp.

methods.name: loadToken
methods.description: Loads a token for a specified device ID and role from persistent storage.

methods.name: storeToken
methods.description: Stores or updates a token for a device ID, role, and scopes, adding it to persistent storage.

methods.name: clearToken
methods.description: Removes a token associated with a device ID and role from persistent storage.

methods.name: normalizeRole
methods.description: Trims whitespace and newlines from a role string.

methods.name: normalizeScopes
methods.description: Trims, filters empty, and sorts a list of scope strings.

methods.name: fileURL
methods.description: Generates the URL for the JSON file storing tokens.

methods.name: readStore
methods.description: Reads and decodes the token store from the JSON file.

methods.name: writeStore
methods.description: Encodes and writes the token store to the JSON file.
